gotchas: Guest booking, no login needed. The search deep link /search/findHotels.mi?destinationAddress.destination=<City%2C%20ST%2C%20USA>&fromDate=MM%2FDD%2FYYYY&toDate=MM%2FDD%2FYYYY&roomCount=1&numAdultsPerRoom=1 works; dismiss the privacy notice ('x'). Results card 'View Rates' (same tab) -> 'Select a Room and Rate' -> a room's 'View Rates' button -> each rate offers Member and Non-Member 'Select' buttons (aria-label 'Select <rate> Non-Member Rate') -> 'Complete Your Booking', one page. The room is held for about 15 minutes.

Guest fields carry no autocomplete attributes; the name-attribute substrings in the overrides resolve. Country/Region defaults to USA; the phone has a country-code select (+1 USA) beside input[type=tel].

The card form is Gr4vy secure fields: four iframes, all iframe[src*='secure-fields.marriott.gr4vy.app/input.html'] with no distinguishing title. By position: nth=0 card number (cc-number), nth=1 expiry (cc-exp, MM/YY), nth=2 CVC (cc-csc, required), nth=3 card postal code (postal-code). Pass `frame` as "iframe[src*='gr4vy.app/input.html'] >> nth=N".

The card postal code lives on the Gr4vy host, so filling it from the address token raises a SEPARATE destination approval for secure-fields.marriott.gr4vy.app, after the one for marriott.com. Two owner prompts plus the live CVC is a lot to land inside the room hold: warn the owner before the card step.
Final button not reached in testing; nothing was submitted.

overrides.street1: input[name*="line1" i], input[name*="street" i], input[name*="address1" i]
